source_refs.note: Exercise 10.1, Question 3: book page 278 (Q1-Q24). The book prints no answers for Exercise 10.1.

blocks.explanation:
Yahan \(\tan x\) ka square diya hai. Pehle \(\tan^{2}x\) ko akela karenge, phir \(\pm\) ke saath square root lenge.
Is se do basic equations banti hain: \(\tan x = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\) aur \(\tan x = -\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\).
Find kya karna hai? Chaaron principal solutions aur general solution.
Rule: tangent ka period \(\pi\) hai, \(2\pi\) nahin; isi liye aakhir mein families chhoti ho jayengi.
Plan: dono cases alag alag hal karo, phir \(n\pi\) laga kar jodo.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(3\tan^{2}x = 1\).
Maloom karna: principal solutions aur general solution.
Tareeqa: \(\tan^{2}x\) ko akela karo, \(\pm\) ke saath square root lo, do basic equations hal karo. Tangent ka period \(\pi\) yaad rakhna hai.

Akela kar ke square root lein
\[\tan^{2}x = \dfrac{1}{3}\]
\[\tan x = \pm\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\]
Kyun: dono taraf 3 se divide kiya, phir square root liya. Positive aur negative dono ka square \(\frac{1}{3}\) hai, is liye \(\pm\).
Dhyan dein: \(\pm\) bhoolne se aadhe jawab (quadrant II aur IV wale) gum ho jate hain.

Reference angle
\[\tan\alpha = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\]
\[\alpha = \dfrac{\pi}{6}\]
Kyun: table mein \(\tan\frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\) hai (yani \(30^{\circ}\)). Dono cases ka reference angle yahi hai, kyunke dono ki positive value ek hi hai.

Jab \(\tan x = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\)
Tangent positive hai, to \(x\) quadrant I ya III mein:
\[x = \dfrac{\pi}{6}\]
\[x = \pi + \dfrac{\pi}{6} = \dfrac{7\pi}{6}\]
Kyun: "All, Sin, Tan, Cos" ke mutabiq tangent quadrant I (sab positive) aur quadrant III mein positive hai.

Jab \(\tan x = -\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\)
Tangent negative hai, to \(x\) quadrant II ya IV mein:
\[x = \pi - \dfrac{\pi}{6} = \dfrac{5\pi}{6}\]
\[x = 2\pi - \dfrac{\pi}{6} = \dfrac{11\pi}{6}\]
Kyun: jahan tangent positive nahin, wahan negative hai: quadrant II aur IV.

General solution
Tangent ka period \(\pi\) hai. Dekhiye: \(\frac{7\pi}{6} = \frac{\pi}{6} + \pi\) aur \(\frac{11\pi}{6} = \frac{5\pi}{6} + \pi\). Is liye do families chaaron jawab samet leti hain:
\[\left\{\dfrac{\pi}{6} + n\pi\right\}\]
\[\cup \left\{\dfrac{5\pi}{6} + n\pi\right\},\ n \in \mathbb{Z}\]
Kyun: tangent har \(\pi\) ke baad dohrata hai, is liye \(n\pi\) jama karte hain. \(2n\pi\) wali chaar families likhna bhi sahi hai, magar lamba hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\tan^{2}\dfrac{\pi}{6} = \left(\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)^{2} = \dfrac{1}{3}\]
\[3 \cdot \dfrac{1}{3} = 1\]
Kyun: baqi teen angles par bhi \(\tan x = \pm\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\) hai, aur square karne se sign khatam ho jata hai, to har jagah \(3\tan^{2}x = 1\) poora hota hai.
blocks.final_answer: Principal solutions \([0, 2\pi]\) mein: \(x = \frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{5\pi}{6}, \frac{7\pi}{6}, \frac{11\pi}{6}\). General solution: \(\left\{\frac{\pi}{6} + n\pi\right\}\) \(\cup\) \(\left\{\frac{5\pi}{6} + n\pi\right\}\), \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\). (Period \(2\pi\) ke saath likhein to chaar sets: \(\frac{\pi}{6}, \frac{5\pi}{6}, \frac{7\pi}{6}, \frac{11\pi}{6}\), har ek \(+ 2n\pi\).)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 10.1 ke jawab chhape hue nahin hain. Is page ka har jawab hamara apna hai: qadam ba qadam hal kiya gaya, computer algebra system (sympy) se alag se check kiya gaya, aur ek solution book se bhi milaya gaya. Kitab ke examples ki tarah hum principal solutions \([0, 2\pi]\) mein aur general solution sets ke union ki shakal mein dete hain. Aap apna kaam yahan wale hal se mila kar dekh sakte hain.
